speaker: Commissioner Gordon

opening.speaker: Commissioner Gordon
opening.text: That is an impressive amount of effort to inspect my stationery.

opening.speaker: DETECTIVE
opening.text: The records do not agree. You refused to explain why.

opening.speaker: Commissioner Gordon
opening.text: And you mistook that for permission to open my safe. Close it. Then ask your questions.

lines.speaker: DETECTIVE
lines.text: Alex said the crash site had not been located. Was the wreckage found afterwards?

lines.speaker: Commissioner Gordon
lines.text: Yes. A later search located the wreckage. The account you read did not contain the subsequent recovery findings.

lines.speaker: DETECTIVE
lines.text: Then the original mission report is not the whole record.

lines.speaker: Commissioner Gordon
lines.text: Correct. An incomplete account is not permission to invent its missing pages.

topics.label: What about John and the artifact?

lines.speaker: DETECTIVE
lines.text: Were John's remains recovered? Was the artifact there?

lines.speaker: Commissioner Gordon
lines.text: Neither John's body nor the artifact was recovered from the wreckage.

lines.speaker: DETECTIVE
lines.text: That does not establish whether he died there.

lines.speaker: Commissioner Gordon
lines.text: No. Nor does it establish that he survived. Keep those statements separate.

lines.speaker: DETECTIVE
lines.text: What did the later examination establish about the crash?

lines.speaker: Commissioner Gordon
lines.text: The aircraft had been sabotaged. That finding belongs to the separately registered follow-up, not the original mission entry.

lines.speaker: DETECTIVE
lines.text: So the archive needs a different reference. I have been looking under the mission number.

lines.speaker: Commissioner Gordon
lines.text: Ask Drebin to cross-reference the recovery and technical follow-up. Do not treat a different registration as evidence that you already know who caused it.

closing.speaker: DETECTIVE
closing.text: I will check the archive's follow-up records. Properly, this time.

closing.speaker: Commissioner Gordon
closing.text: An ambitious experiment. Begin by using the door instead of dismantling it.

objective: Ask Drebin to cross-reference the original mission with the wreckage recovery and technical follow-up.
summary: Gordon states that the wreckage was found later. Neither John's body nor the artifact was recovered. The aircraft had been sabotaged; the recovery and technical follow-up use a separate registration. This does not establish who caused the sabotage or whether John survived.
